Volkswagen Passat production history

Updated 2026-08-20. The Volkswagen Passat has been produced since 1973. Generations: B1 1973-1980, B2 1981-1988, B3 1988-1993, B4 1993-1996, B5 1996-2005, B6 2005-2010, B7 2010-2014, B8 2014-2023, B9 since 2023 (estate only in Europe). Production of the saloon for Europe ended in 2022.
